statements.reason: The procedure requires inspecting mounting security, but does not say loose bolts were found.
statements.statement: Loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS.

evidence_quotes:
All vehicle shortcomings will be reported on DA Form 2404 Equipment Inspection and Maintenance
Worksheet or DA Form 5988-E (automated) (DA Pam 738-750) immediately after the PMCS, and before
taking corrective action.
statements.reason: The reporting requirement names both forms and specifies the timing.
statements.statement: The shortcoming must be reported on DA Form 2404 Equipment Inspection and Maintenance Worksheet or DA Form 5988-E (automated) immediately after the PMCS.

evidence_quotes:
All vehicle shortcomings will be reported on DA Form 2404 Equipment Inspection and Maintenance
Worksheet or DA Form 5988-E (automated) (DA Pam 738-750) immediately after the PMCS, and before
taking corrective action.
statements.reason: Shortcomings must be reported before corrective action.
statements.statement: The shortcoming must be reported before corrective action is taken.

evidence_quotes: All vehicle deficiencies will be reported in the equipment record.
statements.reason: Vehicle deficiencies must be reported in the equipment record.
statements.statement: The shortcoming will be recorded in the equipment record.

evidence_quotes:
Tighten mounting bolts to
40 lb-ft (54 N•m).
statements.reason: The starter procedure specifies that torque.
statements.statement: The specified tightening torque for the starter mounting bolts is 40 lb-ft (54 N•m).
